Prepare step by step

  1. Describe the project in broad terms and keep addresses or documents off this page.
  2. Verify location, credentials, service area and availability directly.
  3. Ask each professional the same questions about scope, price, timing, permits and warranties.
  4. Share only what you choose; no plan is sent automatically and paid status is not a recommendation.
